feeds.title: Glamour Daze
feeds.description: A lavishly illustrated archive and blog of vintage fashion and beauty, with gorgeous imagery, films, educational reading and pretty things to buy.

feeds.title: Secret Plus Size Goddess
feeds.description: The ramblings of an Award Winning plus size 40 something lady with a new found lust for life!!

feeds.title: Vintage Life
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Sammy and I created this website as a place for myself and others to share their love for finding, selling, and styling vintage. I believe that all women can make vintage fashion a part of their wardrobe, and I hope that you'll join me on this journey as we spread vintage love together!

feeds.title: Blue 17- Vintage Clothing Blog
feeds.description: Blue17 vintage clothing contains fashion, accesories and vintage clothing for Men & Women. Blue17 is also known for cheap vintage clothing that doesn't make any sacrifices on quality.

feeds.title: Vintage Fashion and Glam
feeds.description: Author started this blog to for all things vintage fashion and glam. I have an obsession for all fashion, but there is something about vintage fashion that I love more than anything.

feeds.title: Harlow Darling Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Harlow, a vintage lover from Brisbane. My blog focuses on the styles of the art deco period and features both authentic vintage pieces from the 1920s, 30s & 40s, as well as modern reproductions of clothing from these eras. My blog explores creating modern everyday looks with vintage elements.

feeds.title: Atomic Redhead
feeds.description: Atomic Redhead, focuses on my adventures, which mostly include shopping for vintage clothing, fun roadside Americana, museums, and amusement parks. Sometimes I share tips and tricks regarding vintage clothing and furnishings.

feeds.title: StrangeBlog
feeds.description: Strangeblog is dedicated to Kali Pappas' many interests, including fashion (historical, vintage, retro, plus-sized, and in-between-sized), vintage home decor, Jane Austen's Emma, music and Disney theme park audio, and more!

feeds.title: RetroCat
feeds.description: A blog about vintage fashion and beauty by vintage lover and makeup addict Sandra.

feeds.title: The Dressed Aesthetic
feeds.description: The Dressed Aesthetic is a vintage fashion blog, with a focus on vintage and vintage-inspired clothing, wardrobe management, outfit planning, and sewing. A scientist by day & vintage huntress by night. Here I chronicle my daily outfits, musings, & inspirations.

feeds.title: Vintage Inspired Clothing & Costumes
feeds.description: VintageDancer.com links to the best vintage inspired clothing, costumes, shoes, and accessories for sale online from 1900 to 1960s. Learn fashion history and easy DIY costume tips.

feeds.title: calivintage
feeds.description: A blog by erin perez hagstrom. You're reading calivintage, a collection of personal style, fashion inspiration, and street style photography written by a california girl with a love for everything vintage.

feeds.title: Gracefully Vintage
feeds.description: Vintage fashion blogger from Sydney, Australia. Kayla made GracefullyVintage as an outlet to share and document Her outfits. The name comes from one of Her favourite actresses and style icons, Grace Kelly and Kayla's love of vintage fashion.

feeds.title: The Eye of Faith Vintage 11.11.11.
feeds.description: CLOTHING & LIFESTYLE Blog: Explorations of the [past/present/future] *all vintage images used for educational purposes only- to inspire thinking to new generations*

feeds.title: Emily's Vintage Visions
feeds.description: A blog by Emily. She always loved vintage and historic fashions. Emily's main focus is the 18th century but she loves the classy look of the 1920s, through the 1950s. Emily enjoys researching, collecting, and creating historic clothing just for fun.

feeds.title: My Vintage Love
feeds.description: Michelle created a place for lovers of all things vintage to learn more about vintage beauty and fashion and be inspired. Michelle is a makeup artist fascinated with vintage beauty and fashion, mostly from the 1920's, 30's, 40's and 50's.

feeds.title: somethingdefinitelyhappened
feeds.description: A vintage fashion and style blog

feeds.title: Dalena Vintage
feeds.description: Inspiration for vintage lovers, hopeless romantics, wanderlust addicts. Dalena Vintage was born from an ongoing love affair between one girl and her adoration of vintage clothing. Each piece is hand-selected for it's beauty, purity and quality. We like to think the result is a collection of dreamy vintage in which girls can lose themselves.

feeds.title: Nook Vintage
feeds.description: Nook Vintage is a store that opened at 258 Johnston St Fitzroy in January 2010. The shop is very special and has a vast range from vintage clothing to industrial homewares and accessories.

feeds.title: Zeus Vintage Blog
feeds.description: Zeus Vintage is one of the fastest-growing and most exciting brands to hit the online luxury vintage market. Check out our blog featuring Fashion Trends, News, Lookbooks and much more featuring hand-picked Designer Vintage Clothing!

feeds.title: Flashback Summer
feeds.description: Flashback Summer is a vintage lifestyle blog with an intercultural twist. The blog hits on aspects of vintage lifestyle, especially clothing and old-fashioned hospitality, along with discussions on cultural issues, traditional clothing, and controversial subjects relating to fashion, race, and culture.

feeds.title: Evelyn Wood Vintage Fashion House Blog
feeds.description: Your guide to everything vintage fashion and style. The Vintage fashion House is an online resource for the modern women with a particular vintage taste who wants to take control of her own unique personal style.

feeds.title: Empress Vintage Blog
feeds.description: Empress Vintage a new vintage boutique in Berkeley, CA featuring high quality vintage clothing & accessories for women and men.

feeds.title: A Curious Fancy
feeds.description: A Curious Fancy is a plus size fashion blog with a side of vintage. Ragini is a plus size fashion blogger with a fondness for the eccentric. She is unapologetically fat and femme. This blog is a chronicle of her personal style over the years. Her blog has been featured in Grazia and Marie Claire India.

feeds.title: Vintage Chic
feeds.description: This is my blog for posting images from the large collection of old catalogs and fashion magazines I have piled up in my spare room. I'll be posting stuff from between the 1940s and the 1980s. A warning to visitors: Some of these images are scary!

feeds.title: Vintage Fashion Guild Blog
feeds.description: The best site for help and support on vintage fashion, with online resources, articles, forums and membership. the Vintage Fashion Guild (VFG) is an international non-profit organization dedicated to the education, promotion and preservation of vintage fashion.

feeds.title: The Vintage Dress
feeds.description: Providing material for all your bygone era dress fantasies since 2010..

feeds.title: Collectif London Blog
feeds.description: Vintage inspired 1940s and 1950s clothing and accessories. Collectif was established in the year 2000.

feeds.title: The House of Foxy - The Musings of a Foxy Lady
feeds.description: The House of Foxy is a ladies wear brand of vintage inspired clothing made in Britain (formerly known as 20th Century Foxy). Our mission is to bring beautiful, demure and glamourous clothing to the world - inspired by a truly golden era.

feeds.title: Vintage-Retro
feeds.description: We are dedicated to collecting and presenting information on vintage fashion from the Victorian era to the 1980s.

feeds.title: Deluxe Redux
feeds.description: eluxe Redux is a vintage fashion blog based in Chicago celebrating fashion history. Deluxe Redux features designers, vintage boutiques and fashion history aficionados.

feeds.title: Vintage Clothing and Retro Style
feeds.description: A collection of articles that provide historical information about fashion in the 20th Century. Get updates on the fashion designers, the vintage clothing, and the retro style that is still popular today.
